THE EAST AFRICAN COMMUNITY CUSTOMS
MANAGEMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025
An Act of the Community to amend the East African
Community Customs Management Act to streamline
and rationalise customs administration, operations and
procedures; and to provide for related matters.
Date of assent: 30th November, 2024
Date of Commencement: 26th September, 2025
ENACTED by the East African Community and assented to
by the Heads of State.
